comment: The preloaded-intermediates list every CI leg launches with (STEALTHFOX_INTERMEDIATES): EMPTY (format 1, no certificates), so a leg never asks Mozilla for the real list (the core neither downloads nor checks when the variable is set) and every run has the same bytes. Set by scripts/ci_lab_intermediates.py. To change the list, change ci/intermediates.json and sha256 here in one commit; `set` refuses to go on when they differ. The real list is looked at only by what the release proves about the product.
